title: cctest: pre-release checks for clinical AI systems that combine components
description: First public version of a pre-release test with two modules: an agreement test for combined language models (error rate among agreed answers, unanimous-wrong rate against naive, closed-form and permutation baselines, Wilson 95% intervals) and a data-layer test for multi-input fusion models (AUROC change from each added layer with paired bootstrap intervals, and a flag for layers whose held-out performance does not exceed chance). Reproduces the published analyses of two 2026 papers. Code is MIT licensed. Data files are CC BY 4.0 for the author's contributions, with third-party carve-outs listed in NOTICE.
